stage_inference.fill: rotlab.focus FocusNet plan 'fill' (letterbox-fill patch tokens dropped; checkpoint sinks 0, tol 1e-3) = the shipped fill-drop ONNX; scored by `python -m rotlab.focus eval CKPT --mode fill --canvases C --sets <final sets>` (gated by camp_final.check_score(sha, canvas, 'fill'))
stage_inference.null: full-token RotNet; scored by `python -m rotlab.camp_eval CKPT --canvases C --sets <final sets>` (gated by camp_final.check_score(sha, canvas, None))
stage_inference.code_tree: /workspace/code-final (campaign code + lead overlay); regression check 29 Sep: fresh_diode + fair re-scored from this tree equal the development stores exactly (3 stages, 3,990 predictions, max |dconf| 0)

route_threshold_note: legacy single-router field = Pro route; the released tiers (below) carry their own route thresholds
decoder: argmax + local circular mean over +-10 bins (core.decode); conf = mass within +-10 deg

abstain.rule: answer iff conf >= threshold; routed images take the large stage's prediction and confidence; effective strict = max(standard, strict)
abstain.standard_definition: answers ~90% of the calibration images (release final_stats.Tier t_cov90)
abstain.strict_definition: lowest threshold with answered error rate <= 1% (calibration sets weighted equally)
abstain.calibration: rotlab.calib meva_cal / poly_cal / oi_cal; route = small-stage confidence quantile at the 10% / 20% route share
abstain.sources: pod /workspace/ops/thresholds-v2-M3.json (small GF-SV3-kdM3 fill, large M3-SOUP8) and /workspace/ops/thresholds-v2-nanoSV2.json (nano GF-SOUP-SV2 fill)
abstain.formats: these are the PyTorch/FP32 thresholds; per-format thresholds (INT8 / FP16 / Core ML) are calibrated on the same calibration sets after the freeze and never on final sets

selection: Candidates chosen on development panels only (grid-free dev, newval, five-seed, cue-free photos, R-LiViT dev, W panels) under research/grid-fix/PREREG.md; never on the final sets, which are unopened at freeze time.
